reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage performs exact need-to-capability matching, preserves the allowed record identifiers, and marks missing matches as unsupported. The supplied output keeps n06-r01 and n06-r07 unsupported while mapping the six exact capability handoffs as direct.

prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported = coverage == 'direct'. That causes covered/direct records to be sorted ahead of truly unsupported needs, contradicting the declared role to rank unsupported needs before covered needs. The final priorities show direct records n06-r02, n06-r03, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r06, and n06-r08 flagged as unsupported=true while actual unsupported records n06-r01 and n06-r07 are flagged false and pushed to priorities 7 and 8.

synthesize_recommendation follows its local declaration by retaining the eight-item window and building the recommendation from the first already-ranked priority record. However, its recommendation is downstream of the inverted unsupported flag and bad ordering produced by prioritize_needs, so the reported top_need is behaviorally contaminated even though the local synthesis logic is not independently contradicted by the supplied package.
